questions.q: Mass of CO₂ from 25 g CaCO₃? CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂
questions.model: Moles of CaCO₃: 25 ÷ 100 = 0.25. 1:1 ratio, so 0.25 mol CO₂. Mass = 0.25 × 44 = 11 g.
